segments.translation: 所以说青出于蓝而胜于蓝

segments.sceneTitle: 我爱你 -不 烧烤那事儿
segments.text: - The once mighty- - You know what? Forget it.
segments.translation: -昔日王者 -算了 不劳你驾

segments.sceneTitle: 我爱你 -不 烧烤那事儿
segments.text: No, no, no, no. I'm good. I'm good.
segments.translation: 不不不不 我来 我来

segments.sceneTitle: 我爱你 -不 烧烤那事儿
segments.text: Hey, hey. Guys. Who wants to go out like a champ?
segments.translation: 队员们 想不想以赢家的身份走出去

segments.sceneTitle: 我爱你 -不 烧烤那事儿
segments.text: - Yeah! - Me!
segments.translation: -想 -我

segments.sceneTitle: 我爱你 -不 烧烤那事儿
segments.text: I love it! Okay, Jordy, you inbound to Luke.
segments.translation: 就这态度 好 乔迪 你发球给卢克

segments.sceneTitle: 我爱你 -不 烧烤那事儿
segments.text: Manny, you set a pick on Luke's man
segments.translation: 曼尼 你把卢克的防守挡开

segments.sceneTitle: 我爱你 -不 烧烤那事儿
segments.text: and roll to the bucket.
segments.translation: 然后去球篮下面候位

segments.sceneTitle: 我爱你 -不 烧烤那事儿
segments.text: - Luke, you know what to do. - No, I don't.
segments.translation: -卢克你知道该怎么做了 -我不知道

segments.sceneTitle: 我爱你 -不 烧烤那事儿
segments.text: - Bounce-pass to Manny. - But, Dad-
segments.translation: -传地板球给曼尼 -但是 爸

segments.sceneTitle: 我爱你 -不 烧烤那事儿
segments.text: Coach, Manny hasn't taken a single shot all season.
segments.translation: 教练 曼尼整个赛季都没进过球

segments.sceneTitle: 我爱你 -不 烧烤那事儿
segments.text: Then chances are he'll be open.
segments.translation: 机会来时他会把握住的

segments.sceneTitle: 我爱你 -不 烧烤那事儿
segments.text: Okay, guys. Let's bring it out.
segments.translation: 好的 队员们 上场了

segments.sceneTitle: 我爱你 -不 烧烤那事儿
segments.text: Hey, hey. Bring it in.
segments.translation: 嘿 都伸出手来

segments.sceneTitle: 我爱你 -不 烧烤那事儿
segments.text: Let's show these guys what kind of team they're about to beat.
segments.translation: 给对手秀秀我们的气势

segments.sceneTitle: 我爱你 -不 烧烤那事儿
segments.text: Huh? "Li'I Dribblers" On three.
segments.translation: 数到三喊"小德伯必胜"

segments.sceneTitle: 我爱你 -不 烧烤那事儿
segments.text: One, two, three- Li'I Dribblers!
segments.translation: 一二三 小德伯必胜

segments.sceneTitle: 我爱你 -不 烧烤那事儿
segments.text: Okay, red ball. Side out. Here we go.
segments.translation: 红队场边发球 开始

segments.sceneTitle: 我爱你 -不 烧烤那事儿
segments.text: What's my coaching philosophy?
segments.translation: 我的执教理念是什么

segments.sceneTitle: 我爱你 -不 烧烤那事儿
segments.text: - Give a kid a bird- - Yes!
segments.translation: -给孩子一只鸟 -就是这样

segments.sceneTitle: 我爱你 -不 烧烤那事儿
segments.text: And he becomes one of those weird dudes
segments.translation: 他就会像那些怪叔叔一样

segments.sceneTitle: 我爱你 -不 烧烤那事儿
segments.text: who walks around with a bird on his shoulder.
segments.translation: 把鸟放在肩膀四处晃荡

segments.sceneTitle: 我爱你 -不 烧烤那事儿
segments.text: But give him a pair of wings,
segments.translation: 但给他一双翅膀

segments.sceneTitle: 我爱你 -不 烧烤那事儿
segments.text: he can fly.
segments.translation: 他就能飞

segments.sceneTitle: 我爱你 -不 烧烤那事儿
segments.text: Unless he has absolutely no hand-eye coordination.
segments.translation: 除非他眼高手低 技术太烂

segments.sceneTitle: 我爱你 -不 烧烤那事儿
segments.text: Okay, I support you.
segments.translation: 没事 我相信你

segments.text: Mom.
segments.translation: 妈

segments.text: That was 20 minutes.
segments.translation: 你晚了20分钟

segments.text: Mom, I am so, so sorry.
segments.translation: 妈 我非常非常抱歉

segments.text: I know it's no excuse,
segments.translation: 我知道我不该这样

segments.text: but I've been feeling a lot of pressure at school.
segments.translation: 只是我人在学校身不由己

segments.text: You know, with friends.
segments.translation: 来自朋友圈的压力

segments.text: And I love you so much,
segments.translation: 我非常非常爱你

segments.text: and I appreciate everything you do for me.
segments.translation: 你为我所做的一切我都心存感恩

segments.text: I'm still your little girl.
segments.translation: 我还是你的乖乖女

segments.text: Oh, honey! That was so sweet.
segments.translation: 亲爱的 妈妈听你这么说真开心

segments.text: Can I get $20? A bunch of us are going to a movie,
segments.translation: 能给我20美元吗 我们想去看电影

segments.text: and we're gonna get something to eat afterwards.
segments.translation: 然后再去吃个饭什么的

segments.text: Jenna's brother's gonna take us home.
segments.translation: 珍娜她哥会载我们回家的

segments.text: Okay. Of course. Sweetie, you know what? Take 40.
segments.translation: 好 没问题 亲爱的 给你40

segments.text: - Oh, my gosh. - Yeah. That's right.
segments.translation: -天啊 -没什么 给

segments.text: - Thanks, Mom. - Go on. Have a great time.
segments.translation: -谢谢妈 -去吧 玩得开心

segments.text: Oh, Alex, honey? When you're out shopping,
segments.translation: 艾丽克斯 亲爱的 逛街的时候

segments.text: you might wanna pick yourself up a training bra.
segments.translation: 最好给自己买件胸罩

segments.text: I know you don't need one now,
segments.translation: 我知道你现在用不上

segments.text: but your little boobies are gonna come in soon.
segments.translation: 但你的小咪咪早晚会长出来的嘛

segments.text: Mommy loves you, kitten!
segments.translation: 妈妈爱你 小猫猫

segments.text: Mwah! Mwah!
segments.translation: 亲亲 亲亲

segments.text: Teach her to screw with me.
segments.translation: 看你还敢耍我

segments.text: I set a pick and then rolled towards the basket.
segments.translation: 我阻断了防守 然后跑到球篮下

segments.text: Luke passed to me. I shot the ball and almost made it.
segments.translation: 卢克把球传给我 我投篮 几乎进了

segments.text: I bought Lily the cutest little dress today.
segments.translation: 我今天给莉莉买了件非常萌的裙子

segments.text: And then I stole the ball from the other team,
segments.translation: 然后我从对手那里抢到球

segments.text: did a 360 and almost dunked it.
segments.translation: 然后360逆天翻转上篮 几乎灌篮

segments.text: That's nice.
segments.translation: 真牛

segments.text: Ay. I just had the best day today with Lily.
segments.translation: 我今天跟莉莉玩得太开心了

segments.text: That girl's so sweet.
segments.translation: 那小姑娘萌翻了

segments.text: I have a game next Saturday. You could come.
segments.translation: 我下周六有比赛 你来看吧

segments.text: No, it's okay. I wouldn't want to embarrass you.
segments.translation: 不了 谢谢 我不想去给你丢脸

segments.text: I'll probably take Lily out for cupcakes. Mm-hmm.
segments.translation: 那天我应该会带莉莉去吃纸杯蛋糕

segments.text: Okay.
segments.translation: 哦

segments.text: Any suggestions?
segments.translation: 提点一下

segments.text: I usually go with earrings.
segments.translation: 我一般用耳环哄她开心
